source.title: Pathfinder Society Quest #22: Friends in Need

items.name: Elemental Draw
items.text: The baby scamp swarm can sense creatures with a connection to the elements. It is drawn to creatures that have cast an elemental spell or used an elemental ability within the last round.

items.name: Elemental Conduit
items.text: A creature within the swarm's space that casts an elemental spell or uses an elemental ability does not need to make a flat check. Additionally, the baby scamps empower their spell causing the save DC to be 1 higher.

items.name: We're Helping!
items.text:
The Young scamps all try to help the creatures in their space at the same time. Each creature must attempt a DC 17 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is affected as if Guidance had been cast on them.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Fascinated until the end of their next turn.

items.name: Wing Buffet
items.text: Each creature within the baby scamp swarm's space takes 3d4 bludgeoning damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save save).
